Could you suggest some science books written by Albert Einstein and Lincoln Barnett?

gpt-4o-mini.title: The World As I See It
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A collection of essays by Einstein reflecting on his thoughts about life, society, and the universe.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The universe and Dr. Einstein
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A compelling exploration of the cosmos and the theories of relativity, this book by Albert Einstein and Lincoln Barnett delves into the profound implications of Einstein's work in the field of science. gpt-4o-mini.title: Einstein on Race and Racism
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A compilation of Einstein's thoughts on race, addressing social justice and his views on prejudice.

gemma2:9b.explanation: A seminal work co-authored by Einstein, exploring fundamental concepts in physics.

gemma2:9b.title: Through the Eyes of a Physicist
gemma2:9b.explanation: Barnett's book delves into Einstein's theories and their impact on our understanding of the universe.

gemma2:9b.title: Einstein for Everyone
gemma2:9b.explanation: An accessible introduction to Einstein's work, written by Barnett for a general audience.
